title: Citrate canonical contract-address table
description: Canonical, federation-wide source of truth for every Citrate contract deployed to a given chain. See contracts/addresses/README.md.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id (40204 for Citrate testnet).

deployer.description: EOA that signed the deploy ceremonies.

deployedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent ceremony.

regenerator.description: Path (relative to citrate-chain repo root) of the script that regenerates this file.

contracts.description: Map of contract name → deployed address. Names match the Solidity contract names exactly (case-sensitive).

aaStack.description: ERC-4337 v0.7 stack (EW-S1). Sourced from .env.testnet + DeployAA.s.sol broadcast.

genesis.description: Contracts allocated at genesis (e.g., Arachnid deterministic CREATE2 deployer).

precompiles.description: Native executor precompiles — implemented in core/execution/src/precompiles, NO on-chain bytecode by design (eth_getCode returns 0x). Standard EVM precompiles 0x01-0x09 also present but omitted here. NOT contracts — listed for consumer convenience.

genesisHash.description: Block-0 hash of the network generation this book describes (eth_getBlockByNumber(0x0).hash). Readers compare it with the chain they talk to before trusting any address.

source.description: The books this file is generated from (path relative to the citrate-chain repo root, sha256 of the file bytes, and the deployer / timestamp each records).

governance.description: GOVERNANCE and GUARDIAN timelock addresses (each also a contracts entry). Archived books may also carry descriptive fields (type, threshold, minDelaySeconds) that were true for their own network only.
